message: The other day, I found myself looking through my pantry for the fifth time this week. I had already organized my hurricane supplies and stocked up on enough canned beans to host a small army. My family teases me about being the gloriously over-prepared person, but I like to think of myself as the family’s safety net. I mean, who wouldn’t want a backup plan for a snowstorm or a heatwave? Just in case, you know? 😄
